title: She Invented Monopoly. She Got $500.
aria: Animated short about Lizzie Magie, who patented The Landlord's Game in 1904, the game that became Monopoly
foot: Narration is an AI voice (Kokoro, af_heart). Music and effects: original score with CC0 samples (VSCO 2 Community Edition, Kenney). Events follow Smithsonian, NPR, the National Women's History Museum and Mary Pilon's reporting; faces, rooms and staging are illustration. Not affiliated with Hasbro or the Monopoly brand.
